prosody.p:
Welcome! Are you ready to dive into the wild, hilarious, and sometimes downright chaotic world of parenthood?
Imagine turning your daily routines into epic adventures—where even making breakfast can feel like a quest, and bedtime... well, that's a saga all its own.

That’s exactly what Jim Gaffigan brings to life in his book, Dad Is Fat.
Drawing from his own experience of raising five kids in a cozy two-bedroom apartment in New York City, Gaffigan shares the funny, bewildering, and honest moments that every parent will recognize.
He draws us in with stories that capture those sleepless nights, the endless negotiations, and those incredible flashes of wonder that make it all worthwhile.

What you’ll find here isn’t just comedy—though there’s plenty of that—it’s the real, unfiltered truth about what it means to be a modern parent.
There’s love, there’s frustration, and there’s a whole lot of laughter along the way.
Together, we’ll explore the absurdities and tiny delights that make up family life—from the bedtime battles to the chaos of family outings.
Every little moment becomes a story, and every story reminds us just how much creativity, patience, and resilience it takes to survive—and maybe even thrive—in the middle of all this beautiful mess.

So, let’s jump in together.
This journey through Gaffigan’s eyes is a chance to laugh, reflect, and rediscover the everyday magic that makes being a parent so unforgettable.
